parsed.summary: The PR reverts the hash method of Field to be immutable, which addresses the issue but may introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: Reverting the hash method may break existing behavior that relies on the current hash implementation, especially in complex model setups.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that the change does not introduce new issues or regressions.
